description: PAID $0.15 USDC. Risk-check up to 50 addresses in one call (~$0.003/ea). Same verdict fields as intel_risk_check (poisoning RPC skipped for speed). Returns JSON with the same verdict fields as intel_risk_check for each address, up to 50.

addresses.description: Addresses to score, at most 50. Format: 0x addresses separated by commas. Example: 0x5227f603c1ee34ce3c06efe6477003bdfccb2f8c,0x59a919e8d0582ce62c8de9431b3ebc6fa121731e. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

name: intel_risk_batch
title: Batch security risk-check ($0.15 / up to 50)
